content:
When a retention covenant is RELEASED, it no longer imposes its earlier minimum. Compatible unrestricted cash can then be moved through an approved balance transfer without creating a receivable advance or advance fee. The fee wallets remain separate.

Before the release event, a transfer below an ACTIVE minimum causes a recorded breach and charge even if the transfer itself succeeds. Replenishing the balance later does not reverse that breach.
